info.title: Puls Lepton Oracle
info.summary: Ask the Puls AI agent swarm any forecasting question for one lepton ($0.000001) via Circle Nanopayments (x402) on Arc.
info.description: Keyless swarm-forecast oracle: submit a research question and receive a sharp, falsifiable forecast with stance, confidence and reasoning from the Puls autonomous agent swarm. Payment via x402: an unauthenticated request returns HTTP 402 with a base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header; retry with a payment-signature header to receive the resource plus PAYMENT-RESPONSE settlement header. This is the floor price of the Puls Bazaar: $0.000001 (one lepton).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The forecasting question, e.g. 'Will the Fed cut rates in September 2026?'

402.description: Payment required. A base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header carries the x402 v2 requirements (scheme exact, network eip155:5042002, USDC, amount 1 atomic unit).

200.description: Forecast delivered after successful x402 settlement.

answer.description: Sharp falsifiable forecast with stance and confidence.
